products.title: 10x20 Custom Canopy Tent Wall – Dye-Sublimation Printed
products.description:
Specsheet Warning Label Fire Certificate

20' Full Wall – Single-Sided (Wall Only)

Enhance your canopy setup with a durable 20' Full Wall, perfect for increased privacy, shade, branding space, and wind protection. Made from 600D weather-resistant polyester and printed using high-quality dye sublimation, this wall delivers sharp, vibrant graphics built to withstand outdoor conditions.
Frame not included.

Features

- 🛡️ 600D Weather-Resistant Polyester: Strong, long-lasting fabric ideal for outdoor environments.

- 🎨 Full-Color Dye Sublimation: High-resolution printing on a white base for vivid, fade-resistant graphics.

- 🔧 Wall Only: Hardware and frame sold separately.

- 🖨️ Imprint Method: Full-color dye sublimation for premium visual impact.

Kit Includes

- 🧱 1× 20' Full Wall (Single-Sided)

- ⚠️ Frame NOT Included

Materials

🧵 Wall: 600 Denier Polyester

Certifications

🔥 Meets FR Rating Requirements (Fire-Resistant)

Primary Usage

Ideal for outdoor vendor setups, festivals, trade shows, food booths, markets, and branded activations.
